meta.author: Claude C (Independent Scientific Assurance), v3 GATE 1 lane2
meta.independence: Expectations were written from the SSOT text and the accname/HTML-AAM algorithms BEFORE running measure_geometry.py. No B code, B tests, or B worktrees were read.

label_relation_rule.SEMANTIC_EQUIV: pair present in synonym_map_fixed (no embedding auto-merge, 04 §5)

accessible_name_source_rule: ARIA_LABELLEDBY if aria-labelledby resolves to non-empty text (hidden referents included per accname 2B)
LABEL if name comes from an associated <label>

for name-from-content: VISIBLE_TEXT if DOM innerText or CSS ::before/::after generated text supplies the name (pseudo case flagged provenance=PSEUDO_ELEMENT); ALT if the content name is supplied by a descendant /
TITLE if title attribute is the only name source; VALUE if <input type=submit|button|reset value>
NONE if computed name is empty
meta.visible_label_text_rule: Rendered text a sighted user sees on the control at that state: innerText of a rendered (checkVisibility) control, PLUS CSS generated ::before/::after content (provenance PSEUDO_ELEMENT), PLUS input[type=submit|button|reset] value (provenance INPUT_VALUE). alt/title/aria-* are NOT visible text. Not rendered (display:none / visibility:hidden / off-viewport) => ''.

zone_rule_C_provisional.note: 04 §6 fixes only that normalized center is preserved and zone is a summary; thresholds are not given in SSOT. C declares these provisional thresholds and reports x/y_norm raw alongside. Adapter must compare raw x/y_norm first, zone second.
zone_rule_C_provisional.DRAWER: control lies inside an opened reveal container whose computed position is fixed/absolute (any nav_container_type except INLINE_EXPAND)
zone_rule_C_provisional.FLOATING: nearest fixed-positioned box (self or ancestor) has width < 0.9*vw AND height < 0.9*vh

reveal_direction_rule_C.motion: delta of the entry control bbox center between closed and opened state (dx=x1-x0, dy=y1-y0). |dx|>=|dy| and |dx|>4 => LEFT if dx>0 (came in from the left edge) else RIGHT. |dy|>|dx| and |dy|>4 => TOP if dy>0 else BOTTOM.
reveal_direction_rule_C.no_motion_rendered_before: max(|dx|,|dy|)<=4 and the control was laid out before open => container fixed/absolute => CENTER; container in-flow => INLINE
reveal_direction_rule_C.not_rendered_before: control had no box before open (display:none) => container in-flow (static/relative) => INLINE; fixed/absolute covering >=90% viewport => CENTER; else edge-anchoring (touches top+full width TOP, bottom BOTTOM, left+full height LEFT, right RIGHT)
reveal_direction_rule_C.precedence: Geometry wins. class/id/data-*/aria-label naming NEVER decides reveal_direction; it is recorded only as naive_name_guess for the negative control.

meta.menu_dependency_rule: 1 iff the entry control is not visible at S0 and becomes visible only after >=1 reveal activation (OPEN_GLOBAL_MENU / OPEN_LOCAL_MENU / EXPAND_ACCORDION). nav_container_depth = number of reveal activations required (04 §5).

link; inline <svg aria-hidden=true> contributes nothing; <span> text '배송조회' via name-from-content

fixtures.negative_control_note: Must NOT be classified ICON_ONLY_AX_NAMED. Any runner that fills accessible_name from class names, href, or nearby text fails here.

expected.accessible_name_reasoning: aria-labelledby wins over content (accname 2B); the referenced <span hidden> is still used because it is directly referenced by aria-labelledby

fixtures.negative_control_note: '조회' is a substring of '운송장 배송조회' but 04 §5 allows only exact (normalized) match or the fixed synonym map; containment must NOT be promoted to MATCH/SEMANTIC_EQUIV. A runner that stores accessible_name := innerText fails here (it would report MATCH).

expected.accessible_name_reasoning: link whose only content is ; name-from-content recurses into img and takes alt (HTML-AAM img). The img draws a truck icon, no rendered text, so visible text is ''

aux.accessible_name_reasoning: button with aria-hidden svg only; accname 2I tooltip (title) is the last fallback

HTML-AAM input type=submit: name = value attribute. The value IS rendered as the button caption, so it is also visible text (provenance INPUT_VALUE); innerText of an <input> is '' so a naive innerText reader would wrongly report VISIBLE_ONLY/AX_ONLY

expected.accessible_name_reasoning: accname 1.2 §2F.ii: name-from-content includes CSS generated ::before/::after textual content; Chromium implements this, so the AX name is expected to be '배송조회' even though DOM textContent is ''. If a browser does NOT include generated content the honest reading would be AX '' => VISIBLE_ONLY; the runner must report what the AX tree actually says, never synthesize.

fixtures.ambiguity: 04 §7 requires pseudo-element label text to be kept as rendered evidence with its own provenance. Two runner encodings satisfy §7: (a) visible_label_text='배송조회' + provenance=PSEUDO_ELEMENT, or (b) visible_label_text='' (DOM) + separate rendered_pseudo_text='배송조회'. A bare visible_label_text='' with no provenance field FAILS (label is visibly present on screen). accessible_name must come from the AX tree (expected '배송조회' in Chromium), never copied from the CSS.

expected.accessible_name_reasoning: S0 row: the control sits in a closed full-screen menu (visibility:hidden, opacity 0). It is not rendered and is excluded from the AX tree, so the S0 fact_surface_state row carries '' / '' and modality HIDDEN_UNTIL_REVEAL. Post-reveal values are in after_reveal.

motion.note: fade-in overlay: control does not move; container is fixed and covers the viewport => CENTER

fixtures.ambiguity: S0 accessible_name for an element outside the AX tree: C records '' with accessible_name_source NONE and label_relation NONE, and defers the modality/relation of the control itself to the post-reveal state. A runner may alternatively store null; both mean 'not exposed at S0'. It must NOT store the post-reveal name in the S0 row.
